Vira is Sweden's national card game and the most elaborate of the Solo family (with Solo Whist and Préférence). Tradition holds it was invented around 1810 at Vira courthouse when a storm snowbound the court; two Walloon gentlemen are said to have devised it. It was the most advanced and popular card game in Sweden for a long time; popularity declined after Contract Bridge arrived in the early 1930s because Vira never became standardized like Skat.
